versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/C '
        - ' >> *\AppData\local\temp\*.bin'
condition: selection
